title: Ex8 - Open: Time series interpretation
text:
Run the code below in a new cell:

```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

url = 'https://github.com/muratfirat78/CPP_Datasets/raw/main/temp.csv'
dfTemp = pd.read_csv(url)
dfTemp['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(dfTemp['timestamp'])

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16,10))
ax = fig.add_subplot(111)
ax.plot_date(dfTemp['timestamp'], dfTemp['temperature'], color='black')
plt.title('Temperature readings at different times')
plt.xlabel('Time')
plt.ylabel('Temperature')
plt.show()
```

Look at the temperature time series chart. Describe the pattern: is there a daily cycle visible? Any overall trend? What time period does the dataset cover?
answer: A clear daily temperature cycle is visible. The dataset covers a few days starting March 20, 2015. The solution uses ax.plot_date(dfTemp['timestamp'], dfTemp['temperature'], color='black').
